_comment: Labeled routing fixture for the Phase-5 classifier recall gate (plan §6 gate #1). Each case maps a natural-language query to the provider type(s) that should be routed to, given the three live registered leaves: command (cli-health.commands), component (ui-health.surfaces), record (swarm-manager.records). Recall is measured over (query, expected-type) pairs; uncertain queries are expected to widen (recall over precision). Extend this fixture as new live types register.

cases.query: how do I restart a scenario from the command line
which CLI command shows a scenario's logs
command to run a scenario's test suite
what is the CLI invocation to stop a running scenario

is there already a delete confirmation dialog component
reuse an existing theme toggle UI element
existing frontend page that renders a dashboard
how did we fix the voice auto-stop bug previously
